title: memoir entry frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of a single memoir entry file (markdown + YAML frontmatter), after the YAML has been parsed to JSON. Normative text: docs/SPEC.md v0.1 (draft), section 3. Validates canonical (v0.1) entries only; legacy dialects (SPEC.md Appendix A) are handled by reader compatibility rules, not by this schema. Unknown fields are permitted everywhere by design: readers ignore them, writers preserve them.

type.description: Entry type. Answers: what should a tool DO with this entry when it loads?

name.description: Human-readable title (or slug) for the entry.

description.description: One-line summary. Indexes and pickers render this.

schema_version.description: Entry schema version. Absent means 1. Forward-version rule: quarantine + degrade, never guess (SPEC.md section 6).

project.description: Project this entry is scoped to; absent means global.

aliases.description: Other names/phrasings a reader might search for this entry under. Retrieval SHOULD weight above body prose (SPEC.md 3.2).

oneOf.title: fact
oneOf.description: Something true about the world, the project, or the environment.

oneOf.title: preference
oneOf.description: How the user wants things done; a standing instruction.

oneOf.title: decision
oneOf.description: Something decided, recorded so it is not silently relitigated. `why` and `rejected` are required-encouraged: not schema-required (auto-capture legitimately lacks them), but validators warn on a missing `why`.

rejected.description: The alternative considered and rejected, and why it lost. (Field name matches deployed stores; not `rejected_alternative`.)

hidden.description: true = absolute tombstone. Sticky across merges regardless of dates (SPEC.md 5.3.1).

superseded_by.description: Link name of the replacing decision.

oneOf.title: lesson
oneOf.description: A behavior correction learned from experience. Without a trigger and an application rule it is an anecdote, not a lesson.

trigger.description: The situation that should fire this lesson.

fired_count.description: Times this lesson demonstrably fired and changed behavior. Outcome-loop hook; optional.

oneOf.title: goal
oneOf.description: The standing objective that orients sessions.

oneOf.title: next_action
oneOf.description: A concrete, resumable piece of work; the handoff unit.

added.description: When the action was added. REQUIRED: the temporal-tombstone comparison (done_at vs added) is against this field; without it, completion semantics are undefined.

done_at.description: Temporal tombstone: suppresses copies whose `added` is not later than this; a re-add with a later `added` is a deliberate revival and survives (SPEC.md 5.3.2).
